caption: The columns are θ = 0°, 45°, 90° and 135°; the rows are quantised ρ in pixels, rounded to the nearest pixel. The marked cell at (ρ = 0, θ = 135°) holds two votes, so it is the peak that gives the line y = x.

spec.title: Accumulator for two edge points
spec.aria: A four-row accumulator table whose columns are θ equal to 0, 45, 90 and 135 degrees; one cell holds two votes and is marked.
